acceptance.inference_scope: conditional on the preregistered synthetic two-path channel distribution, 6-RB/30-kHz PUSCH, injected AWGN, and tested payload generation; not field or deployment qualification
acceptance.intra_symbol_control: echo Doppler frozen at OFDM-symbol starts; retains inter-symbol aging and removes within-symbol phase evolution
acceptance.protocol: paired static, symbol-static, and continuous echo Doppler at 750 and 1,500 Hz over independent seeded two-path channel draws; channel draw is the statistical unit; equal channel weighting
acceptance.reference_bler_upper_bound_method: one-sided Clopper-Pearson bound on channel-level any-failure prevalence; conservative upper bound for mean BLER

simultaneous_claims: continuous-Doppler paired BLER increase at 750 Hz
continuous versus symbol-static intra-symbol BLER increase at 750 Hz
continuous-Doppler paired BLER increase at 1,500 Hz
continuous versus symbol-static intra-symbol BLER increase at 1,500 Hz

symbol_static_control.model: freeze Doppler phase at each OFDM-symbol start, preserving inter-symbol aging
